answers.core: I don't think this could be implemented as an addon
answers.workaround:
well instead of
```gdscript
var last_item = pool_str.pop_back()
```
I could do something like
```gdscript
var size = pool_str.size()
var last_item = pool_str[size-1]
pool_str.remove(size-1)
```
but I'm not sure if it will work as fast as if it were a built-in method.

also as you can see it doesn't look so clear.
besides, I'm not sure if it is possible to move this part of the code into a separate method, and even if it is possible, if such a method would be convenient.
